name: strety-connect
description: Connect Claude to Strety, the EOS software your team already runs on. Manage To-Dos, Rocks (Goals), Scorecard metrics, Issues, and Headlines live via the Strety API; build a pre-L10 prep pack from real team data; and mirror Strety into Cloud Brain so the EOS Operator plugin works from live numbers. OAuth setup is a guided one-time flow — tokens stay local, auto-refreshed.
